cues.ERR_ARM_FORWARD: Raise your arm out to the side, in line with your body, not in front of you.
cues.ERR_ELEVATED_SHOULDER: Keep your shoulder down; don't shrug.
cues.ERR_HEAD_TO_SIDE: Keep your head straight; don't tilt it.
cues.ERR_LOW_ABDUCTION: Lift your arm higher, at least to shoulder level.
